summary: 18 Java files: GasAnalysisController (5 modes) and MovementController (7 modes), joined by the shared events turn/stop/resume. Every one of the 81 requirements is traced in result_codegen.json. The issues below are design choices and invented defaults; no requirement is unimplemented.

issues.title: Operations CD-OP1..4 realised as VehicleActuator commands, not operation-subpackage classes
issues.raw: Profile section 5 describes an operation as a class with a no-argument compute() made of `this.field = expr` assignments that read only sensors and constants. move(lv, a) and changeDirection(l) need the controller variables a and l as arguments, and changeDirection's specified behaviour is a three-way choice (left->Right, right->Left, front->Back at lv). Neither fits that shape. move, randomWalk and shortRandomWalk are provided by the Vehicle (CD-ARCH2), so all four are methods of VehicleActuator called from step's actions; changeDirection is built on move.
issues.fix_directive: If the coverage or profile check insists on operation-subpackage classes for CD-OP1..4, report the mismatch between the operation profile and parameterised platform operations to the operator; do not inline the operations into step and do not drop their arguments.

issues.title: Waiting's during action randomWalk() issued on entry to Waiting
issues.raw: The step profile has no during actions. randomWalk() runs until a later move supersedes it (CD-OP2), so it is issued on every transition into WAITING (the resume transitions, including the Waiting self-loop) and once in the constructor for the initial entry (CD-MV-Beh1 has no action of its own).
issues.fix_directive: None unless a verifier reports randomWalk on the resume transitions; the alternative, an eventless self-loop in Waiting, would diverge.

issues.title: Odometer sampled through a sensor method, not an input event
issues.raw: CD-Evt3 is typed 'event', but the odometer is read inside actions (d0 on entry to Avoiding, d1 on the TryingAgain->AvoidingAgain transition) and never triggers a transition. It is the zero-argument sensor method OdometerSensor.odometer().
issues.fix_directive: None expected; the method should become a sensor variable in the model.

issues.title: Final states realised as terminal modes
issues.raw: GasDetected->Final (CD-GA-Beh6) targets the terminal mode CONCLUDED, which the requirements leave unnamed. Movement's Found->Final (CD-MV-Beh9) has no trigger, guard or action, so FOUND itself is terminal and Beh9 has no Java transition of its own. CD-DC1 is otherwise one transition per Beh; CD-GA-Beh1 and CD-MV-Beh1 are the currentMode initialisers.
issues.fix_directive: If Isabelle reports deadlock in CONCLUDED or FOUND, the cause is the terminal mode the requirements specify, not a missing transition; do not add transitions that are not in the requirements.

issues.title: turn/stop/resume declared as OutputEvent (sender) and InputEvent (receiver) records with the same names
issues.raw: GasAnalysisController sends OutputEvent.Turn/Stop/Resume and MovementController receives InputEvent.Turn/Stop/Resume, so each becomes one shared event of the module. In Java, AnalysisActuator passes each to MovementController.step as it is sent; this is the only link between the two subsystems (CD-ARCH2).
issues.fix_directive: If the module does not connect them, check that the shared-event matching is by record name.

issues.title: Representation of Intensity, Chem and GasSensorReading
issues.raw: Intensity is real (double), the totally ordered type the comparison needs. Chem is a record holding a nat species code, so equality is its only operation. GasSensorReading is List<GasSensor> (a sequence) with no wrapper type; it is the type of the gas event and of gs.

issues.title: Constant values
issues.raw: The requirements say the constants are configured at start-up but give no values. THR=1.0, LV=1.0, EVADE_TIME=1, STUCK_PERIOD=2, STUCK_DIST=1.0, OUT_PERIOD=1. All are integral, so the constants interface does not round them, and they are small enough that both outcomes of every guard are reachable in a bounded model (since(T) at AvoidingAgain is at least EVADE_TIME=1 < STUCK_PERIOD).
issues.fix_directive: Replace with the deployment's configured values.

issues.title: Initial values of state variables
issues.raw: Only gs has a specified initial value (empty). Chosen: sts=noGas, ins=0.0, anl=Front, a=Front, l=front, d0=d1=0.0, evasionStart=0. On every path each is assigned before it is read.

issues.title: Function details the requirements leave open
issues.raw: analysis: gasD iff some value is for the target chemical (a Chem given to ChemicalSensor at construction) with i > 0. Sensor direction: position p (1-based) faces the p-th Angle in declaration order (Left, Right, Back, Front), wrapping. Empty reading: intensity 0.0 and location Front. Neither is called on an empty reading, because GasDetected is reached only after analysis found a value.
issues.fix_directive: Adjust to the platform's sensor layout and detection criterion.

issues.title: Peak intensity and location span every chemical in the reading
issues.raw: CD-Fn2 and CD-Fn3 take the maximum over the whole sequence, not only over values for the target chemical. A stronger non-target chemical can therefore steer the robot, or reach thr, once analysis has reported gasD. Implemented as written.
issues.fix_directive: If only the target chemical should count, the requirements need to say so.

issues.title: Unguarded NoGas->Reading, and timing of autonomous transitions in step()
issues.raw: NO_GAS->READING has no trigger and no guard, as CD-GA-Beh3 specifies. It is not a cycle, because READING needs a gas event. In Java, autonomous transitions (ANALYSING, NO_GAS, GAS_DETECTED, AVOIDING_AGAIN) fire on the next step() call, and an event passed in that call is not handled by the next state. Likewise, a turn sent while Movement is in AVOIDING_AGAIN is ignored in Java, whereas in the model the sender waits.
issues.fix_directive: None for the model. A Java runtime should call step(null) until the mode is stable before it delivers the next event.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile, coverage, profile check, T2M, M2M, M2T, FDR4, Dafny, Isabelle, vacuity) and act on its reports.
